title: Инспектор и кокос  (The Inspector and the Coconut)

scenes.title: The Michelin Inspector
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov welcomes Michelin inspector Alexey Smolin, who praises the signature menu despite a minor spill.

scenes.title: The Coconut Bet
scenes.summary: Senya and Fedya make a reckless bet about whether a falling coconut can knock a person out.

scenes.title: Struck by a Coconut
scenes.summary: After a coconut accidentally hits the inspector, Chef Barinov apologizes and tells Fedya to escort him to his room.

scenes.title: Locked in the Walk-in Fridge
scenes.summary: Fedya reveals to a horrified Chef Barinov that he locked the Michelin inspector in the walk-in fridge.

scenes.title: The Inspector's Wife
scenes.summary: The inspector's wife asks after her husband, prompting Chef Barinov to send Fedya to watch over her.

scenes.title: Escape Through the Vent
scenes.summary: The chefs send Lyova into the air duct to chase the inspector, only to find him hiding behind boxes in the cooler.

scenes.title: Half a Million for Silence
scenes.summary: After Timur bumps the fleeing inspector, the inspector demands five hundred thousand dollars for a good review.

scenes.title: Lyova's Life Savings
scenes.summary: Lyova offers his entire bank savings to pay off the inspector and save the restaurant.

scenes.title: Fedya and the Inspector's Wife
scenes.summary: Fedya admits he seduced the inspector's wife, leading to another brawl before Lyova arrives with the money.

scenes.title: Noise Complaints
scenes.summary: Mikhail Jekovich investigates noise complaints from the hotel room and gets knocked out as well.

scenes.title: Champagne to the Room
scenes.summary: Kostya delivers champagne to the hotel room and mistakenly thinks Chef Barinov is hiding an affair.

scenes.title: Nastya Confronts the Chef
scenes.summary: Nastya confronts Chef Barinov about the woman in his room and threatens to call Elena Pavlovna.

scenes.title: Hostages in the Hotel Room
scenes.summary: Kostya and Nastya are tied up in the room while Chef Barinov sends Senya to guard the inspector in the bathroom.

scenes.title: Hostage and Escape
scenes.summary: The inspector takes Senya hostage to escape up the stairs while Denis frees Kostya and Nastya.

scenes.title: On the Hotel Roof
scenes.summary: Fedya misinterprets Chef Barinov's warning on the roof and pushes the inspector off just as police arrive.

scenes.title: Colonel Elena Pavlovna
scenes.summary: Elena reveals in Barinov's dream that she is an FSB colonel assigned to cover up his scandals.

scenes.title: New Passport and Mustache
scenes.summary: Elena gives Chef Barinov a new passport to flee the country and tells him to shave his mustache.

scenes.title: Robot Lyova and the Wedding
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov discovers Lyova is a robot and Katya is marrying Nagiyev, realizing the whole nightmare is a dream.

scenes.title: What Really Happened
scenes.summary: In reality, Chef Barinov collapsed from shock the moment the Michelin inspector introduced himself.

scenes.title: Eleonora's Confession
scenes.summary: While Chef Barinov lies in a coma, Eleonora confesses that she hired a fake Michelin inspector.
